en: A black-and-white, early-20th-century style postcard showing a large red-brick institutional building in neo-Gothic style behind a tall wrought-iron fence and brick pillars. The façade has stepped gables, arched windows, dormers in the roof, and a central entrance with a small statue above it. Several women, children, and a few men stand or walk along the cobbled street in front of the gate, suggesting a school, orphanage, or hospital setting. A tall tree grows inside the fence, and a gas streetlamp stands by the gate.
